items.summary: Blockchain infrastructure company Coinbase (NASDAQ:COIN) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales falling 18.5% year on year to $1.22 billion. Its non-GAAP loss of $1.36 per share was significantly below analysts’ consensus estimates.
